author_or_account: The Weekly Show with Jon Stewart; Daron Acemoglu and David Autor
title: AI & the Future of Work
discussion_signal: The interview brings two paper authors into a public discussion of what pro-worker AI could look like, which policies might shape it, and whether the incentives exist to pursue it. It extends the conceptual framework into a political-economy question about who directs technological change and whether workers remain participants in the gains.
linked_research_question: What observable deployment choices, worker participation, new tasks, training, pay, and product or service outcomes would show that U.S. AI policy is changing technology direction rather than only describing an aspiration?
limits: The episode is an interview and public explanation, not a causal evaluation of the nine policy directions
The episode does not measure implementation, worker outcomes, or firm behavior
Public discussion by paper authors should not be treated as independent validation of the conceptual framework
